_comment: Explicit CI shard assignment for the browser suite (5 parallel runners since 2026-10-26). Every e2e/*.spec.ts must appear in exactly one group (scripts/e2e-shard.mjs enforces this in CI). E10 generated route coverage replaces the old duplicate axe route loops; focused legacy keyboard/menu/theme regressions remain. Generated scans are split across browser-b/c/d from measured runtimes;  2026-10-06 (PR #266): the generated route scans and the read-only owner/portal section scans run in Playwright parallel mode (both workers), and groups were rebalanced from measured test-seconds after that change (a 158, b 94, c 105, d 133) to roughly 111-126 each. 2026-10-24 (ACC-3): moved revenue-records and website-editor from browser-b to browser-a because browser-b ran 186s against the 180s budget (a 159, b 341, c 299, d 198 test-seconds). 2026-10-25 (MCP-10a): browser-a ran 179s and browser-d 181s against the 180s budget, so feedback.spec.ts (new, ~18 test-seconds) and crm-workspace.spec.ts (~40-55 test-seconds) moved to browser-c, the lightest group (118s). 2026-10-25 (AR-0a): browser-c ran 3.1m against the 180s budget (a 2.7m, b 1.8m, d 2.6m), so crm-workspace.spec.ts (~45-55 test-seconds) moved to browser-b, the lightest group. 2026-10-25 (MCP-1): measured a 2.7m, b 3.1m (over budget once crm-workspace landed), c 2.5m, d 2.4m; system-health.spec.ts (now ~14 test-seconds) moved to browser-d and fleet-report.spec.ts (~16 test-seconds) from browser-b to browser-c. 2026-10-25 (AR-0b): measured a 128s, b 215s, c 183s, d 128s (budget 180s), so crm-workspace.spec.ts (~50 test-seconds) moved from browser-b to browser-a and the three new AR-0b specs (today, customer-record, money-bills; ~30 test-seconds together) went to browser-d. 2026-10-25 (AR-11): measured a 194s (over 180), c 111s; revenue-records (~62 test-seconds) moved a to c without removing tests. 2026-10-25 (AR-11): measured a 188s, b 159s, c 174s, d 173s; moved feedback (~18 test-seconds) from a to b with every test retained. 2026-10-25 (MCP-2 preview-security PR #609 CI): browser-a finished 81 tests but crossed the 180s phase budget; website-editor.spec.ts measured 37 test-seconds and moved from a to d, which completed in 132s, preserving every test and the same phase budget. 2026-10-25 (PR #609 follow-up): the next exact-head run showed browser-d 3.1m (its generated route scan took 201 test-seconds), browser-b 2.0m; move the full website-editor spec from d to b, where measured spare capacity is larger, with no test omitted or budget increased. 2026-10-26 (BILL-1 PR #612): measured a 166s, b 180s (at the budget), c 171s, d 168s; the two smallest specs moved (my-account b to a, two-factor b to c), no test omitted or budget raised. 2026-10-25 (BA-1 PR #610): browser-b passed all 140 checks in 183.48 seconds but crossed 180-second CI budget; browser-d finished in 122.33 seconds. Move complete feedback.spec.ts (~17 measured test-seconds) from b to d, preserving all tests and budget. 2026-10-25 (BA-1 second measured CI): all four browser groups passed tests, but d finished at 180.56s against 180s; b finished at 125.85s. Move intact feedback (~16.2 test-seconds) and today (~11.1 test-seconds) d→b: expected b ~153s, d ~153s. Complete test coverage is preserved without increasing the budget. 2026-10-25 (BA-1 PR #610 current head): browser-b had a real mobile Today overflow and finished 191.87s. Rebalanced intact today (~8s) b→c, books-closing (~10s) b→d, books-reports (~10s) b→a from measured b=191.87/a=136.27/c=145.78/d=145.2. No tests or budget removed. 2026-10-26 (ACC-6 PR #616): browser-c finished 106 tests but crossed the 180s phase budget at 3.1m (a 2.0m, b 1.9m, d 2.1m); moved intact staff-security.spec.ts (~18 test-seconds) and fleet-report.spec.ts (~14 test-seconds) from c to b, the lightest group. No tests omitted or budget raised. 2026-10-26 (ACC-6 PR #616, run 40366925101 on the Codex-fix head): every test passed in browser-a (83) and browser-b (162) but both phases crossed the 180s budget (a 3.1m, b 3.0m; c 2.8m, d 2.7m — an across-the-board slower run, but the budget is the budget). Moved intact my-account.spec.ts (~20 test-seconds) from a to d and fleet-report.spec.ts (~15 test-seconds) from b to c, the groups with the most headroom in that run. No tests omitted or budget raised. 2026-10-26 (ACC-6, run 40370951794): browser-b ran 3.0m against the 180s budget again with all 164 tests passing (a 2.8m, c 2.2m, d 2.4m in the same run), so feedback.spec.ts (~18 test-seconds) and staff-security.spec.ts (~20 test-seconds) moved from browser-b to browser-c, the lightest group. No tests omitted or budget raised. 2026-10-26 (LD-1 PR #618): browser-c ran 3.0m against the 180s budget with all 107 tests passing (accessibility-routes-desk-a 183.7 test-seconds, revenue-records 60.8); moved staff-security (~18 test-seconds) and fleet-report (~15) from c to b, the lightest group, with no test omitted and the budget unchanged — same move that turned ACC-6's browser-c green. 2026-10-26 (LD-1 PR #618, second rebalance): browser-b ran 3.2m against the 180s budget with all 165 tests passing (345 test-seconds after staff-security and fleet-report landed there); measured a 293 test-seconds/2.6m, c 211/2.1m, d 311/2.8m, so website-editor (~35 test-seconds) moved from b to c, the lightest group, with no test omitted and the budget unchanged. 2026-10-26 (ACC-6 merge of LD-1 #625): kept website-editor in browser-b (this branch's measured runs) and assigned LD-1's new lead-staff-detail.spec.ts to browser-b; revenue-records.spec.ts (~59 test-seconds) moved from browser-c to browser-a and my-account.spec.ts (~20) from browser-d to browser-c after run 40386761485 (a 2.3m, b 2.6m, c 3.1m over budget with 109 passed, d 2.9m). No tests omitted or budget raised. 2026-10-26 (CI maintenance; main run 40414391902): a 157.39s, b 126.90s, c 172.09s, d 169.54s; moved complete my-account from c and customer-record plus money-bills from d into b, the lightest group, leaving four runners and 180s budget unchanged. 2026-10-26 (OPS-1 PR #623): the staff generated-route scan moved to its own accessibility-routes-staff.spec.ts and a fifth runner (browser-e) was added after browser-a and browser-d crossed the 180s budget with every test passing; no test omitted and the budget unchanged. 2026-10-26 (DEC-1b merge with main after OPS-1): took main's five-group layout and added the new decisions.spec.ts (~35 test-seconds) to browser-e, which holds the lightest set of specs (main had measured only seven small specs there). No tests omitted or budget raised. 2026-10-26 (DEC-2): new late-fee-waiver.spec.ts (about 5 measured test-seconds in its first CI run) added to browser-e. No tests omitted or budget raised. 2026-10-26 (TFA-2 PR #638): browser-d crossed the 180s phase budget on two consecutive runs at the merged head with its tests passing when the phase was killed (the DEC-2 merge added desk routes its generated scan walks); moved intact books-closing.spec.ts (~10 test-seconds) from browser-d to browser-e. No tests omitted or budget raised.
